definitions.gloss: colloquial name, popular name, common name, nickname
definitions.explanation: An informal or commonly used name for something, as opposed to its official or formal designation. Used for places, laws, phenomena, and other things that have both formal and informal names.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{俗称|ぞくしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}→正式名称：23603_seishikimeishou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This is a colloquial name — the official name is different.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{俗称|ぞくしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「マイナンバー⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: This law is commonly known as the 'My Number Act.'

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}→正式名称：23603_seishikimeishou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{俗称|ぞくしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: That illness is better known by its popular name than by its official one.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{俗|ぞく}→俗：24364_zoku⟧ (popular, common) + {称|しょう} (name, title). Used to identify informal names in contrast to official designations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {俗称|ぞくしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to call by a common name)
- {俗称|ぞくしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (to be known by a colloquial name)
- ⟦{正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}→正式名称：23603_seishikimeishou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{俗称|ぞくしょう} (official name and colloquial name)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通称|つうしょう}→通称：14404_tsuushou⟧: commonly used name, alias (similar but broader; can be semi-official)
- ⟦{愛称|あいしょう}→愛称：12678_aishou⟧: nickname, pet name (affectionate)
- ⟦{略称|りゃくしょう}→略称：13562_ryakushou⟧: abbreviation, shortened name
